selection_rules.alignment: exact pinned GGUF vocabulary only, verify detokenized prefixes against full bytes, expand display windows to UTF-8 boundaries; otherwise mark pending
selection_rules.strict_success_selection: For each distinct failed model_id, representation_name, prompt_template_id stratum, choose one completed strict run with smallest SHA256 of seed|plan_id. Select before examining its trajectory. Reuse a selected success across failures in the same stratum. These are descriptive comparators, not causal controls.
